title: Wedding Videography Cost in Delhi — 2026 Price Guide
excerpt: Planning a wedding in Delhi? Here's a clear, honest breakdown of wedding videography costs in 2026 — what affects the price, what's included, and how to choose the right team.

seoTitle: Wedding Videography Cost in Delhi — 2026 Price Guide | Neelam Films
seoDescription: How much does wedding videography cost in Delhi in 2026? A clear price breakdown — packages, what affects cost, what's included & how to choose the right team.

body.text: A wedding happens once, and the one thing you keep forever is the film. If you're planning a wedding in Delhi or Delhi NCR, one of the first questions is simple: how much does wedding videography actually cost? In this 2026 guide we break down real price ranges, what affects the cost, and how to pick a team you can trust.
Average wedding videography cost in Delhi (2026)
Prices vary a lot depending on the number of days, cameras, crew and the style of edit. As a rough guide for Delhi NCR:

items: Basic (single-day, single camera, simple edit): roughly ₹25,000 – ₹50,000
Standard (multi-camera, highlight + full film): roughly ₹60,000 – ₹1,20,000
Premium (multi-day, cinematic, drone, same-day edit): ₹1,50,000 and above

body.text: These are indicative starting points — your final quote depends on your exact functions (roka, mehndi, sangeet, wedding, reception) and what deliverables you want.
What affects the price?

items: Number of events & days of coverage
Number of cameras and crew members
Cinematic style vs traditional coverage
Add-ons like drone, same-day edit, live streaming & teasers
Final deliverables — highlight reel, full film, reels for social media

body.text: What's included in professional coverage?
A good wedding videography package in Delhi should clearly list what you get. Typically:

items: Multi-camera coverage of each function
A cinematic highlight film (3–5 minutes)
A full-length edited film
Short reels/teasers for Instagram & WhatsApp
Colour grading & professional audio
Backup of raw footage

body.text: Single vs multi-camera: which do you need?

A single camera can miss key moments — the bride's entry, a parent's reaction, the exchange of garlands. Multi-camera coverage captures every angle at once, which is why most couples choose at least two cameras for the main functions. For big venues or 300+ guests, three or more cameras are recommended.
How to choose the right wedding videographer in Delhi

items: Watch full sample films, not just 30-second clips
Confirm how many cameras & crew come with your package
Ask about delivery timelines (highlight vs full film)
Check reviews and years of experience
Get everything — scope, add-ons, price — in writing

body.text: At Neelam Films we've covered weddings and events across Delhi NCR for 30+ years with trained crews, multi-camera setups and well-maintained gear. Share your dates and we'll send a clear, itemised quote.

faqs.q: How much does wedding videography cost in Delhi?
faqs.a: Wedding videography in Delhi typically ranges from ₹25,000 for basic single-camera coverage to ₹1,50,000+ for premium multi-day cinematic coverage. The final cost depends on days, cameras, crew and deliverables.

faqs.q: Should I book photography and videography together?
faqs.a: Yes — booking a combined team ensures the photo and video crews coordinate on the day, so you never miss a moment and the final output has a consistent look.
For peak wedding season (Oct–Feb) in Delhi, book at least 2–3 months in advance. Good teams get booked out quickly.

title: How Much Does It Cost to Record a Podcast in Delhi?
excerpt: Thinking of starting a podcast in Delhi? Here's what studio recording actually costs in 2026 — hourly vs per-episode rates, audio vs video, and what a good package should include.
author: Neelam Films
seoTitle: How Much Does It Cost to Record a Podcast in Delhi? (2026) | Neelam Films
seoDescription: Podcast recording cost in Delhi explained — studio rates, audio vs video podcast pricing, what a good package includes, and tips to save money. 2026 guide.

body.text: Podcasts are booming in India, and Delhi has become a hub for creators, founders and coaches starting their own shows. But before you book a studio, it helps to know what podcast recording actually costs — and what you should get for your money.
Typical podcast recording cost in Delhi
Most studios in Delhi charge either per hour or per episode. As a guide:

items: Hourly studio booking: roughly ₹1,000 – ₹3,000 per hour
Per-episode (record + basic edit): roughly ₹5,000 – ₹15,000
Monthly packages (multiple episodes + editing + reels): ₹20,000 and above

body.text: The right option depends on how often you publish. One-off creators usually book per session, while regular podcasters save money with a monthly package.
Audio vs video podcast — what's the cost difference?

An audio-only podcast is cheaper because it needs fewer cameras and less editing. A video podcast (now the standard for YouTube & Instagram) needs multi-camera 4K setup, lighting and more post-production — so it costs more, but gives you far more reach and content to repurpose into reels.
What a good podcast package should include

items: Soundproofed studio with professional microphones
Multi-camera 4K recording (for video podcasts)
Professional lighting & acoustic treatment
Full editing — cuts, audio mixing, intro/outro
Short reels & clips for Instagram, YouTube Shorts & LinkedIn
Export formatted for Spotify, YouTube & all platforms

body.text: Tips to save money on podcast production

items: Book a monthly package if you publish regularly
Record multiple episodes in one session (batching)
Choose a studio that includes editing + reels so you don't pay separately
Start with one strong format before upgrading

faqs.q: How much does it cost to record a podcast in Delhi?
faqs.a: Podcast recording in Delhi typically costs ₹1,000–₹3,000 per hour, or ₹5,000+ per fully-edited episode. Monthly packages with editing and reels start around ₹20,000.

faqs.q: Do I need a video podcast or audio-only?
faqs.a: Video podcasts get far more reach on YouTube and Instagram and give you reels to repurpose. If growth is your goal, a video podcast is worth the extra cost.

title: Camera on Rent in Delhi: Sony FX6, FX3 & Canon — Rates & Tips
excerpt: Need a pro camera for a shoot in Delhi? Here are typical daily rental rates for Sony FX6, FX3, A7S III and Canon bodies — plus what to check before you rent.

seoDescription: Camera on rent in Delhi: typical daily rates for Sony FX6, FX3, A7S III & Canon, plus lenses, lights and what to check before renting. 2026 guide.

body.text: Buying pro cinema gear is expensive, so for most shoots in Delhi, renting is the smart move. Whether you need a camera for a wedding, a corporate shoot or a short film, here's what you can expect to pay and what to check before booking.
Popular cameras & typical daily rates in Delhi

items: Sony FX6 (full-frame cinema): around ₹8,000 / day
Sony FX3 (compact cinema): around ₹6,000 / day
Sony A7S III (low-light king): around ₹4,500 / day
Canon & Blackmagic bodies: ₹4,000 – ₹9,000 / day

body.text: Rates vary with demand, duration and whether lenses and accessories are included. Multi-day and weekly bookings usually get a discount.
What to check before you rent

items: Is the gear well-maintained and tested before handover?
Are batteries, cards and basic accessories included?
What's the security deposit and ID requirement?
Is a backup body available if something fails on shoot day?
Pickup/drop vs on-site delivery options

body.text: Don't forget lenses, lights & audio

A camera alone rarely gets the job done. Plan for lenses (prime or zoom), lighting (LED panels, softboxes), audio (lav/boom mics) and support (tripod, gimbal). Renting everything from one place saves time and ensures the kit works together.
Booking & deposit process

Most rental houses in Delhi confirm a booking with an advance and a refundable security deposit against valid ID. Book early for peak wedding season, when popular bodies like the FX6 and FX3 get reserved fast.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to rent a camera in Delhi?
faqs.a: Daily camera rental in Delhi ranges from about ₹4,000 for a Sony A7S III to ₹8,000 for a Sony FX6. Rates depend on duration, accessories and demand.

faqs.q: Is a security deposit required to rent gear?
faqs.a: Yes, most rental houses take a refundable security deposit against valid ID, plus an advance to confirm the booking.
